user.title: Fox ESS Cloud
user.description: Enter your Fox ESS Cloud API key. You can generate one from your Fox ESS Cloud account under User Profile → API Management.

device.title: Select Device
device.description: Select the inverter you want to monitor.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Fox ESS Cloud
error.no_devices: No devices found for this API key

set_schedule.name: Set mode schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace the inverter's Mode Scheduler time groups. Times are local HH:MM, end inclusive (e.g. 17:30-21:29). Time not covered falls back to the Remaining Time Mode.

device_sn.name: Inverter SN
device_sn.description: Required only if more than one inverter is configured.

enable.name: Enable scheduler
enable.description: Turn the Mode Scheduler on (default) or off after writing.

groups.name: Groups
groups.description: List of time groups. Each group has start, end, work_mode and optional min_soc_on_grid, max_soc, fd_soc, fd_pwr, import_limit, export_limit, pv_limit. work_mode: SelfUse, Feedin, Backup, ForceCharge or ForceDischarge.

get_schedule.name: Get mode schedule
get_schedule.description: Read the inverter's current Mode Scheduler groups and supported parameters.

device_sn.name: Inverter SN
device_sn.description: Required only if more than one inverter is configured.
